headlines.headline: 2026-27 SEASON TIPS OFF AS RECORD $12.5B LAKERS SALE AWAITS LEAGUE VOTE
headlines.detail: The league's new season opened tonight with a three-game slate, Celtics at Pistons, 76ers at Knicks and Thunder at Spurs, while the agreed $12.5 billion sale of the Lakers to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner still needs NBA Board of Governors approval next month.

headlines.headline: TRADE DEADLINE BUILDS AS WEEK 7 LEAVES PLAYOFF PICTURE SCRAMBLED
headlines.detail: With the Nov. 10 trade deadline two and a half weeks out, front offices are working the phones after a Week 7 slate that saw Seattle fall 17-14 in overtime at Denver, dropping the Seahawks to 3-3.

headlines.headline: WEEK 7'S UPSETS RESHAPE THE PLAYOFF PICTURE HEADING INTO WEEK 8
headlines.detail: BYU's 28-24 stunner over Notre Dame, Ohio State's shaky 19-15 escape past Indiana that cost it QB Julian Sayin to injury, Florida's comeback win over Texas, and Tennessee's rout of Alabama scrambled the committee picture.

headlines.headline: AP PRESEASON TOP 25 LOOMS AS FLORIDA, DUKE HEADLINE NO. 1 RACE
headlines.detail: Florida was tabbed No. 1 in the SEC's preseason media poll and is widely projected as Duke's closest rival for the national top spot; the two meet Dec. 1 in Gainesville as part of the ACC/SEC Challenge.
